sources.entry: Trailer - Managing Pull Requests and Issues For GitHub & GitHub Enterprise.

summary.one_liner: Trailer is a GitHub and GitHub Enterprise client for tracking pull requests and issues across watched repositories, with macOS, iOS, CLI and Android versions.
summary.what_it_does: The README is short and mostly points to maintained binaries: a macOS app, an iOS app, a CLI for Mac, Linux and Windows, and an Android app. It states that Trailer lists all of your watched repositories and lets you set per-repository display settings in Preferences to reduce notification noise and speed up sync. "Set all PRs" and "Set all issues" apply settings to all visible repositories, and filters can narrow which repositories a change applies to. The README also describes Trailer as being split into reusable Swift Packages (TrailerQL, TrailerJson, Lista, Semalot, KeyVine, Maintini, PopTimer). It does not detail further features or setup steps.
use_cases: track pull requests across many GitHub repositories
monitor GitHub issues from a Mac menu bar or phone
reduce notification noise from watched repositories
manage PRs and issues for GitHub Enterprise
check GitHub PR status from the command line on Linux or Windows
notable: Covers macOS, iOS, Android and a CLI for Mac, Linux and Windows
Works with GitHub Enterprise as well as github.com
Per-repository display settings with bulk 'Set all PRs' and 'Set all issues' actions
Core parts split into separately published Swift Packages
caveats: README gives no build or install instructions; binaries are linked from elsewhere
README is brief and does not document features in detail
Trailer lists all watched repositories by default, which can add noise until settings are adjusted
